minutes.headline: Committee backed hiring William Bernard as DPW director and set an in-person June 6 meeting on the salary grid.
minutes.summary: The committee took up a new-hire form for a Director of Public Works and a motion was made to approve it. It then discussed how to revise the Salary Administration Plan grid (fewer grades, more steps, a separate grid for seasonal staff, job-description review). Members agreed to meet in person June 6 from 6:30 to 8:30.

A member suggested a professional firm could do the job comparison, but it would need budgeting and probably a special town meeting.

what_happened.line: A motion was made and seconded to approve hiring William Bernard as Director of Public Works; the minutes record the result as not audible.
The committee discussed redesigning the Salary Administration Plan grid (fewer grades, more steps, a separate seasonal grid) and reached no resolution.
Members raised an across-the-board raise, the cost driven by on-call firefighters, and an outside classification study that would need budgeting and likely a special town meeting.
HR will send job descriptions to members for review before the next meeting.
The next meeting was set for June 6 at 6:30 pm, in person, location to be determined.

why_it_matters: The salary grid sets pay for town staff, so any redesign or outside classification study could change personnel costs in the town budget, mostly taxes, and might need a special town meeting vote.
The DPW director hire is recorded as moved and seconded, but the minutes do not show whether it passed, so the outcome is not established from this recording.
